title: Pregnant Duo #23
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: German, in her late 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, wavy hair, real pores, real living eyes, 3 hoops piercings set with sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a hair ornament. Painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic, a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cobalt bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of medallion scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme cobalt extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Thai, in her mid 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, and continuing that same broad, continuous, solid silhouette, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward from her thick sturdy torso with no sharp transition anywhere, enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, long glossy black waves, a poised, dramatic expression, elegant updo hair, real pores, real living eyes, 50 segment rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum a hair ornament. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern, a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide silver bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of optical illusion grid wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme silver extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
